query:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ((r."BLOCKED" = 0) AND (r."AVAILABLE" > 0)) THEN (0 + r."AVAILABLE") ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "VALUE"
FROM :rows AS r
WHERE ((RTRIM(r."PLANT") = RTRIM(:p_plant)) AND (RTRIM(r."MATERIAL") = RTRIM(:p_material)))
hana:
PROCEDURE "enterprise::STOCK_AVAILABLE" (
  IN rows TABLE ("PLANT" NVARCHAR(4), "MATERIAL" NVARCHAR(20), "AVAILABLE" BIGINT, "BLOCKED" BIGINT),
  IN p_plant NVARCHAR(255),
  IN p_material NVARCHAR(255),
  OUT result BIGINT
)
LANGUAGE SQLSCRIPT
SQL SECURITY INVOKER
READS SQL DATA
AS
BEGIN
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ((r."BLOCKED" = 0) AND (r."AVAILABLE" > 0)) THEN (0 + r."AVAILABLE") ELSE 0 END), 0) INTO result
FROM :rows AS r
WHERE ((RTRIM(r."PLANT") = RTRIM(:p_plant)) AND (RTRIM(r."MATERIAL") = RTRIM(:p_material)));
END;

semantics.characterComparison: RTRIM preserves ABAP fixed-character trailing-space comparison
semantics.numericBoundary: Source inputs and every intermediate arithmetic value must fit signed ABAP 32-bit integers; target BIGINT extends capacity only after separate qualification
